end.summary:
- Discussed neutralisation in toothpaste, ant stings, and antacids.
- Khushi identified an ant sting as acidic and suggested using a base.
- Practised that acid-base reactions can form salt and water.
- Khushi connected antacid use with reducing stomach acidity.
- Teach-back was not completed; the lesson ended when Khushi said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Khushi practised identifying everyday examples of neutralisation and used the idea that acids and bases can form salt and water. They connected antacids with reducing stomach acidity and asked useful questions about fizzing and safety. There was a mix-up about whether every acid-base reaction makes poison or dangerous gas; it was not clearly corrected before the lesson ended. At home, you can ask Khushi to sort examples such as antacid, toothpaste, and ant sting treatment into acid, base, or neutralisation.
